mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.project_id, m.user_id, m.org_id, po.org_name, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_object_key, m.status, m.joined_at FROM pm_project_member m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pm_project_org po ON po.id = m.org_id AND po.project_id = m.project_id AND po.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND po.deleted = 0 WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.joined_at, m.id
